item.title: Actor Timothy Busfield indicted in New Mexico on 4 counts of sexual contact with a child

item.title: Trump's racist post about Obamas is deleted after backlash despite White House earlier defending it

item.title: Canada and France open consulates in Greenland following tensions over US push for control

item.title: Kylie Verzosa announces engagement to non-showbiz partner
item.description: MANILA, Philippines — Actress and beauty queen Kylie Verzosa has announced her engagement to her non-showbiz partner, entrepreneur Emil Eriksen. Verzosa announced the engagement Friday, Feb. 6, through Instagram Stories, sharing a selfie of the couple in an embrace as she displayed her engagement ring. “It was the best hike ever,” she wrote.
